approvedDeviations.reason: Segmented inactive uses w500 (design-system §6.1 canonical). The figma 782:12073 master left inactive at w700 — a master inconsistency (other variants use w500). impl is correct.
Active label color is #3D3218 per design-system §6.1 (gold-on-dark canonical). figma master 782:12073 used #FFFFFF — a master inconsistency. impl follows the canonical token.

SectionLabel ships lineHeight 24 (12px line-box around a 14px font for vertical centering with the 16-tall gold strip); figma master records the lineHeight at 16.41 (no extra line-box). Visual rendering is identical; the 7.59px delta is a tokenization-style difference, not a visual defect.
Account-card label weight is w700 per AccountCard master; the figma 782:12073 frame used the placeholder master's w900 — a master text-style leftover. impl follows the AccountCard canonical token.
Same as 美元账户 — AccountCard canonical w700, figma master uses placeholder w900. impl correct.

Active sub-tab label color is #24201A per design-system §6.1 (active ink); figma 782:12073 master used #FFFFFF — a master inconsistency. impl follows the canonical token. Aligned with the SGB 银行账户 segmented deviation.
Bottom-nav active-weight follows design-system rule (active 500 / inactive 400); 'SPX 资金账户 虚拟币' master left 首页 at 500 because Home is the master copy-source; on Accounts the active tab is 账户.
Bottom-nav active tab on the Accounts screen is 账户 → w500; figma master 782:12073 mislabeled active=首页 (copy from Home). impl correct.
